description: Video Highlight turns your videos into a searchable library: timestamped transcripts, AI summaries, and the passages you highlighted. This plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to that library for the account you sign in with, so it can find a video by what was actually said in it, quote the transcript, and cite the exact second. It searches your own library only, never the web, and cannot change anything in your account. Works with YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, and your own uploads.

defaultPrompt: What has been said about data centers in my videos? Give me the timestamps.
Recap my latest video in five points, each linked to where it is discussed.
Show the highlights and notes I saved, grouped by theme.
